answer.note: All four ref files hold the same generic text and give no file-specific priority, so I picked from the code. D (dogwhistle/honest.py) is the match. `_verify_history` at lines 175-195 rejects `prereg_commit == ledger_commit`. It also requires `git diff --name-only` to equal only the public digest file. Suggested 60 minutes: about 35 on honest.py, covering the diff check, ancestor check, and source and digest comparison. About 15 on C (visibility.py:191), the sibling `_verify_history`, which has neither the equal-commit rejection nor the changed-files check. That makes it the closest near-miss and a likely regression comparison. About 5 each on heldout.py and study.py. Their `verify_history` functions use a three-commit chain (prereg, seal, ledger) with ancestor checks only, so they don't fit. I didn't run the tests.
